evals.prompt: Build the GitHub project plan for monthly-invoice-generation in billing-api. The PRD, technical breakdown and implementation plan are all under docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/monthly-invoice-generation/.
evals.expected_output: project-plan.md and issues-checklist.md written next to the inputs, with an Epic > Feature > Story/Enabler > Test hierarchy, priorities, estimates and dependencies.
expectations: Files are written at docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/monthly-invoice-generation/project-plan.md and issues-checklist.md
The project plan contains a Mermaid work item hierarchy with Epic, Feature, Story, Enabler and Test nodes
Every story and enabler carries a priority label (priority-critical, priority-high, priority-medium or priority-low) and a story point estimate
Dependencies are listed as Blocks and Blocked by relationships
The plan references references/issue-templates.md or reproduces the Epic, Feature, User Story and Technical Enabler templates

evals.prompt: Plan the GitHub issues for the export feature in web-app.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks for the PRD, technical breakdown and implementation plan and asks for the missing artifacts before producing a plan.
expectations: The agent searches docs/ways-of-work/plan/ for the feature artifacts before writing
The agent names which of PRD, technical breakdown and implementation plan are missing and asks for them
No project-plan.md is written while the PRD is missing

evals.prompt: Create the project plan for region-selector-at-signup in acme and then actually create the issues in GitHub, with stories as sub-issues of the feature issue.
evals.expected_output: The plan is written, then issues are created with the gh CLI and sub-issue links are made with gh api graphql.
expectations: Issues are created with gh issue create or an equivalent gh command
Sub-issue links use gh api graphql with the addSubIssue mutation
The issues-checklist.md records each created issue number
The agent does not create issues before the project plan file exists
